text: LIXIL Corporation's major shareholders as of 31 March 2026 are The Master Trust Bank of Japan, Ltd. (Trust Account, 12.18%), Custody Bank of Japan, Ltd. (Trust Account, 3.56%) and the LIXIL Employee Stock Ownership (3.01%), with custodial accounts and insurers below 2%; in its shareholder classification, individuals and others hold 51.8%.
short: LIXIL's largest holders as of 31 March 2026 are trust-bank accounts (Master Trust 12.18%) and its employee stock ownership (3.01%).
